prior_learnings.title: Resetting a global throttle per test is insufficient - install an unlimited one instead
prior_learnings.relevance: This epic adds Hypothesis property tests over reference counts 1-4, orderings and dimensions. The entry's second half is the load-bearing part here: when a newly added production constraint makes tests slow, question the constraint before exempting the tests.

generation_path_end_to_end.summary: UI -> Rust Tauri command -> newline-delimited JSON over sidecar stdio -> Python IPCServer -> MessageHandler -> TextbrushBackend -> GenerationWorker -> InferenceEngine, and back via a delivery thread emitting IMAGE_READY.
steps: src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs:102-118 writeln!+flush under mutex; :152-175 BufReader line loop forwards as Tauri event 'sidecar-message'
textbrush/backend.py:68-134 builds GenerationOptions, constructs GenerationWorker at :126-133
textbrush/worker.py:298-380 _run loop; :357 result = self.engine.generate(prompt, options)  <-- single point where prompt meets model

resistance_points.title: InferenceEngine.generate() has no reference-image parameter anywhere in the call chain
resistance_points.impact: Widest-reaching change in the epic. Touches the ABC, the concrete engine, the worker, the backend, and both IPC command dataclasses.

resistance_points.title: The engine is constructed once at backend __init__; there is no runtime model-swap path
evidence: textbrush/config.py:57-61 (single backend string fixed at config load)
resistance_points.impact: Model selection is currently fixed for the process lifetime. The epic requires switching models mid-session, including unload/load with a reload-on-failure path (spec 8, 11).

resistance_points.title: model/weights.py is hardcoded to one checkpoint
resistance_points.impact: Needs parameterizing by model id (a registry keyed by model), not triplicating. get_cache_info() at :76-104 is already model-agnostic and reusable. TokenRequiredError / gated-repo handling is a good pattern worth preserving verbatim.

resistance_points.title: update_config is NOT pause-gated today, and there is no config-acknowledgement event type
evidence: textbrush/backend.py:426-474 update_config docstring says it is safe while running
resistance_points.impact: spec 5.4 requires both a pause gate and an explicit ack. Both are new machinery, not adaptations. The existing _pending_startup_config queue-and-replay (handler.py:511-533, :142-159) is the shape to generalize.

resistance_points.title: paused is emitted before the worker is quiescent; an in-flight result lands after buffer.clear()
evidence: textbrush/worker.py _run lets the current generate() finish then buffer.put()s
resistance_points.impact: Directly drives AC-STATE-1's settled-signal and discard requirements. Without it the first image after a reference swap was produced with the OLD references.

resistance_points.title: No file-dialog plugin or dependency exists in src-tauri
evidence: src-tauri/ui/package.json has no deps beyond exifreader
resistance_points.impact: Reference picking starts from zero UI precedent; needs a new Tauri plugin plus a new command. spec 5.2 requires a path-injection seam so selection logic stays testable without driving the native dialog.

resistance_points.title: Aspect ratios are duplicated in four places and the handler already validates a narrower set
resistance_points.impact: Pre-existing three-way drift. The six editing presets must not become a fifth uncoordinated copy.

resistance_points.title: Provenance reaches the UI through the saved PNG file, not through IPC
resistance_points.impact: AC-META-1 forbids persisting reference identity in output files while AC-STATE-2 requires per-result attribution. Reference-related provenance therefore cannot use the existing on-disk channel and must be session-local.

resistance_points.title: No immutable snapshot object exists
evidence: textbrush/inference/base.py:45-61 GenerationOptions is a mutable dataclass
resistance_points.impact: spec 9's snapshot must be introduced, not extended.

resistance_points.title: cli.py is a second composition root and never imports ipc/
resistance_points.impact: Cardinality/preset validation must land in BOTH cli.py and ipc/handler.py. There is no shared validator module today - introducing one is a design choice this epic should make rather than duplicating.

inference_mocking.fake_engine: tests/mocks.py:10-72 MockInferenceEngine implements the ABC; generate(prompt, options) has NO reference parameter - this is the contract point the epic extends
inference_mocking.canonical_pipeline_assertion: tests/test_flux_inference.py:240-311 TestGeneratePipelineInvocation injects engine._pipeline = Mock() then asserts engine._pipeline.call_args.kwargs - this is the pattern for proving exact ordered references reach the pipeline
inference_mocking.real_weights_gate: tests/conftest.py:64-88 flux_engine_session is the ONLY real-weight fixture; used solely by tests/test_reproducibility.py which is marked slow+integration; conftest.py:35-57 auto-skips slow/integration unless --run-slow

testing.hypothesis: st.composite strategy factories + @given + @settings(max_examples=N); examples tests/test_flux_inference.py:18-35, one TestXxx class per invariant group
testing.ipc_integration: tests/test_ipc_integration.py:60-100 StdioPipe full-duplex fake; :28-57 mock_backend fixture; TestUpdateConfigCommand at tests/test_ipc_handler.py:1223-1541 asserts exact backend call kwargs and BUFFER_STATUS payloads
testing.ui: node --test (NOT vitest/jest) over compiled *.test.js, jsdom for DOM; keyboard events already tested via real KeyboardEvent dispatch at src-tauri/ui/main-regressions.test.js:161-224
testing.aria_gap: ARIA attributes exist in source (main.ts:926,959-988; config_controls.ts:372) but NO test asserts them today - AC-ACCESS-1 must establish this
testing.e2e: tests/e2e/test_full_workflow.py is CLI-subprocess based (subprocess.run on the textbrush binary, asserts returncode + stdout/stderr). NO Playwright or Cypress anywhere in the repo.
testing.image_fixtures: NONE exist. All test images are synthesized in-memory via PIL Image.new (147 occurrences). No corrupt/unreadable/truncated image cases exist at all - AC-INPUT-3 needs this built from scratch.

conventions.docstrings: CONTRACT style (Inputs:/Outputs:/Invariants:/Properties:/Algorithm:) for public behavioral functions - see textbrush/inference/base.py:70-131, textbrush/cli.py:34-97, :240-; Google style for small private helpers
conventions.typing: from __future__ import annotations everywhere; modern int | None unions; dataclasses for structured data
conventions.errors: ValueError for validation (often chained 'from e'), RuntimeError for engine/worker state. IPC-layer validation errors are NOT raised - they become ErrorEvent(message, fatal=False) dataclasses sent over the wire (protocol.py:204-208). Reference validation surfaced through IPC must follow the ErrorEvent pattern.
conventions.cli_exit_codes: 0 success; 1 runtime errors (ValueError/RuntimeError -> stderr -> sys.exit(1)); 2 argparse/mutual-exclusivity via parser.error(). Never print to stdout on error; backend.shutdown() guaranteed in finally.

schema_defined_three_times: Rust: src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs:10-15 IpcMessage with UNTYPED serde_json::Value payload; each command hand-builds a json!({...}) literal

cross_language_seams.sync_mechanism: none - comment discipline only. Adding a reference set means three coordinated manual edits with nothing enforcing they happen together.
